headline: Accepted a police facility dog by 10-1 vote; approved software and Catalis agreements and Yale opioid case manager funding.
summary: Committees also approved two tax appeal settlements, a plant donation for DeNicola Park, and Veterans Commission reappointments. Board appointments recommended by Mayor Sendroff passed in committee. A $70,000 special education request for Hamden Public Schools was not heard, because the committee was still waiting for documents.
decisions: Approved settlement agreement in the Walgreen case for 1191 Dixwell Avenue and 2505 Whitney Avenue, unanimously.
Approved settlement agreement in the S Realty Group case for 2742 State Street, unanimously.
Approved accepting a plant donation from Eli's Garden of Healing for DeNicola Park, unanimously.
Approved reappointment of Mike Doyle to the Veterans Commission, unanimously.
Approved reappointment of Reginald Jackson to the Veterans Commission, unanimously.
Approved agreement with Vertosoft for OpenGov software and services, unanimously.
Approved board and commission appointments in Mayor Sendroff's October 21, 2026 memo.
Approved agreement with Catalis Public Works & Citizen Engagement, LLC for the Hamden Police Department, unanimously.
Approved interdepartmental transfer of 2025-2026 fiscal year budget funds from the LC Budget to the Public Works Budget, unanimously.
Approved funding support agreement with Yale University for an opioid case manager, unanimously.
Referred the proposed revised easement agreement for 3360 Whitney Avenue to the Finance Committee for an upcoming meeting.
Referred the proposed Town of Hamden Industrial Expansion Assistance Program to the Finance Committee for an upcoming meeting.
Referred the GNHWPCA sanitary easement order for 151 Arch St, 45 Churchill St, and 90 Santa Fe to the Finance Committee for an upcoming meeting.
Approved accepting a facility dog from Puppies Behind Bars, Inc. for the Hamden Police Department, 10 in favor and 1 opposed.
